threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the Tube' instead of 'the Overground' for anything that doesn’t go underground. Classic rookie mistake.
Caught the 35 last night, and a group of blokes were discussing their failed attempts to woo the same girl. One even recited a Shakespeare sonnet. On a night bus!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I spotted the guy in a full suit, juggling while waiting for a U-Bahn, as if it were the most normal Tuesday in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you see complete strangers sharing a table at a Späti, sipping their drinks while the latest political debate echoes from the nearby Kiezbeisl.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can always spot a real local; they’re the ones who know the exact order to hit the tacos at La Taqueria right before closing.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a tuxedo ride the 47 while eating a burrito. Muni really is the great equalizer; fancy and funky all at once.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists think all plazas are just for photos, but locals use places like Plaça del Sol to catch up with friends over a vermut, not for selfies.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones at the terrace still asking for a ‘small coffee’ instead of a ‘cafè petit’—and looking mildly confused when it doesn’t come in a to-go cup.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think waiting 15 minutes for a bus is a nightmare. Welcome to Hackney, where it’s just a warm-up.
Saw a bloke on the 196 last night, passionately arguing with a lamppost about the merits of pineapple on pizza. The lamppost stayed silent.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a guy in a full business suit selling homemade falafel outside the Rathaus Neukölln. Only in Neukölln, right?

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Friedrichshain, you can find a street art installation that changes weekly, making every walk feel like a mini-gallery tour. Never seen that anywhere else!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by how they know the best alley for taco trucks—while tourists are stuck at that one crowded spot on Mission.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Watched a guy in a full tuxedo get on the 31 while juggling a bouquet. Just another Friday night in the TL.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think every bar is a tapas bar; they miss out on the local vermouth spots where you get olives and a real vibe, not just the usual pinchos.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot them by the way they insist on saying 'Hola' to every single doorman like it’s a personal greeting. Locals just nod and move on.
